test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e**. 'Find'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct word to fit the blank is: **'Find'.**
 
• In the given context, the sentence is referring to a study done in 2005, which is in the past.
 
• A **modal** is always followed by the** V1** form of **verb**.
 
 
• ​For example: I **can** **do** it. (Here, 'can' is modal and 'do' is the V1 form of verb)
 
 
 
• ​Similarly, in this context, 'did' is an auxiliary verb. Hence, it must be followed by the **V1 form** of verb.
 
• 'find' is the V1 form of verb and hence, it must fit the blank.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The thought here is that because saliva is slightly alkaline, stimulating it by chewing gum after eating may help neutralize the acidity in your mouth and throat. While a very small study from 2005 did **find** some merit to this approach, the size of the study makes it difficult to (5)_______ any real conclusions.'*

1b
